name: Tear the Wound (Ex)
body:
Prerequisites: Two-Weapon Fighting, Opportunities Aplenty class feature

Benefit(s): If you hit an opponent with both your primary-hand and off-hand weapons, you deal your opportunities aplenty damage an additional time. You can only deal this additional damage once each round.
